title: Three Months and One Short Beam
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：roof　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 roof 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the builder ① mended the roof that no assistant in the site would have counted, and he said the mending was the whole of the month. The ② roof, meaning the cover itself and not the beam, ran three months and stayed uncounted in the book; a roof, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ roof in that site had the same short beam beside it, and the ④ roof at the far wall, meaning the brick they kept for the children to lay and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A roof, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the builder said the counting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the roof was the whole of the matter, meaning the shelter and not the cover. The ⑥ roof, meaning the shelter and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; roof, he said, is either something you mend or the only word that means both a cover and a shelter. He said the shelter is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ roof had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short beam. The ⑧ roof of the whole thing, the builder wrote in October, was one site and three months of counting; roof, he said, is either the brick at the far wall or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ roof I remember is the cover counted in the plan, which closed in 1987 and is still counted as the quietest in the site. A ⑩ roof, my mother said in 1989, is the only cover that improves by being counted; every roof, she said, is a shelter that has agreed to look like a cover. She said the shelter was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 屋顶（指工地里每一片旁边的那一片）
B. n. 屋顶（指那片屋顶本身，与短短的横梁相对）
C. 固定搭配：mend the roof 修这一片屋顶
D. n. 屋顶（指留给孩子们砌的那一块）
E. n. 屋顶之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的屋顶之事）
F. n. 屋顶（指施工图里写到、被清点的那一片）
G. n. 屋顶、遮蔽（指一件事里人人都建却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 遮蔽（抽象总称，指人人都建却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: mended the roof that no assistant in the site would have counted
The roof, meaning the cover itself and not the beam
the roof at the far wall
the roof was the whole of the matter
the roof had become a line in a plan
The roof of the whole thing
A roof, my mother said in 1989

answers.why: mend the roof 意为“修这一片屋顶”，1980 年那位施工员把工地里没有一位帮工肯清点的一片屋顶做了一遍。
roof 意为“屋顶”，指那片屋顶本身而不是短短的横梁，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被清点。
roof 意为“屋顶”，指工地里每一片旁边的那一片，每一片旁边都有同一根短短的横梁。
roof 意为“屋顶”，指最远那面墙体的留给孩子们砌的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
roof 意为“屋顶、遮蔽”，指一件事里人人都建却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片遮蔽就是那件事的全部。
roof 意为“遮蔽”，指人人都建却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片屋顶，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
roof 意为“屋顶”，指施工图里写到、被清点的那一片，到 1985 年这一片成了施工图里的一行。
roof 意为“屋顶之事”，施工员十月写道，整件事的屋顶之事是一处工地和三个月份的清点。
roof 意为“屋顶”，我记得的是施工图里清点过的那一片，1987 年建成了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一片。
roof 为抽象总称，母亲 1989 年说，屋顶是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的屋顶。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1980 年那位施工员修了工地里没有一位帮工肯清点的一片屋顶，他说这一遍才是那个月份的全部。（mend the roof）
那片屋顶，指的是那片屋顶本身而不是短短的横梁，经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被清点。（roof）
那处工地里每一片屋顶旁边都有同一根短短的横梁。（roof）
最远那面墙体那片屋顶，指的是他们留给孩子们砌的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（roof）
叔叔说这片遮蔽就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那片屋顶。（roof）
1989 年母亲说，屋顶是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的屋顶。（roof）
answers: In 1980 the builder mended the roof that no assistant in the site would have counted, and he said the mending was the whole of the month.
The roof, meaning the cover itself and not the beam, ran three months and stayed uncounted in the book.
Every roof in that site had the same short beam beside it.
The roof at the far wall, meaning the brick they kept for the children to lay and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the roof was the whole of the matter, meaning the shelter and not the cover.
A roof, my mother said in 1989, is the only cover that improves by being counted.
